title: Prostaglandin Analogs for Hair: What the Research Shows

seo_description: What a meta-analysis of randomized trials shows about topical prostaglandin analogs and hair, how prostaglandin D2 differs, and the safety questions raised.
notes: Citation style v2: 3 studies, each cited once, all in the second half; Key Takeaways and FAQ carry no links.
